content:
> **Executive Summary:**
>
> * Cuisine Wat Damnak, located in Siem Reap, [Cambodia](/destinations/cambodia/), is the country's sole representative on the Asia's 50 Best Restaurants list, offering a tasting menu that changes bi-weekly based on micro-seasons. The experience, lasting 2.5 hours, showcases indigenous Khmer ingredients with French culinary techniques.
> 
> * Chef Joannès Rivière, a French native, established Cuisine Wat Damnak to elevate Cambodian flavors, utilizing hyper-seasonal local ingredients such as forest fruits and Tonle Sap fish. AGS offers priority reservations, skip-the-line access, and luxury private transfers for this year-round, advance-booking-required experience.
>
> *Related: Explore our [Premium Southeast Asia Tours](/tours/) luxury itinerary.*

## The AGS Executive Summary
Experience Cambodia's only entry into the Asia's 50 Best Restaurants list. Cuisine Wat Damnak elevates indigenous Khmer ingredients using brilliant French culinary technique.

## The Operator & Origin Story
Chef Joannès Rivière grew up in France but spent decades mastering Cambodian flavors. He recognized that while Khmer food was complex, it lacked a high-end platform. He opened Cuisine Wat Damnak to showcase hyper-seasonal, obscure local ingredients (like hidden forest fruits and Tonle Sap fish) using the refinement of a Parisian kitchen.

## The Itinerary & Deep Dive
Arriving at the beautiful, traditional wooden house in Siem Reap, you are seated in an intimate, air-conditioned dining room or the lush garden. 

The tasting menu changes every two weeks, dictated entirely by micro-seasons. You might experience a delicate slow-cooked beef cheek with profound local herbs, or pan-fried Tonle Sap croaker fish. The meal is a masterclass in subtlety and balance, accompanied by a phenomenal, curated wine list.

## Experience Data
| Metric | Details |
|---|---|
| **Vibe / Atmosphere** | Sophisticated, Innovative, Tranquil |
| **Duration** | 2.5 Hours |
| **Physical Demand** | None |
| **Best Paired With** | A final celebratory dinner in Siem Reap. |

## Sequencing Chef Joannès Rivière’s Tasting Menu Around Siem Reap Tee Times
Because [Cuisine Wat Damnak](/destinations/cambodia/) operates as a multi-course evening degustation lasting 2.5 hours inside a tranquil garden house between Wat Damnak and the Siem Reap River, it serves as the quintessential celebratory finale after an 18-hole morning round at [Angkor Golf Resort](/courses/cambodia/angkor-golf-resort/) or [Phokeethra Country Club](/courses/cambodia/phokeethra/). Groups teeing off at 07:30 on Sir Nick Faldo’s 7,279-yard Seashore Paspalum championship layout typically finish on the 18th green by 12:00 PM, leaving a generous five-hour window to return to [Raffles Grand Hotel d'Angkor](/accommodations/cambodia/raffles-grand-dangkor/) or [Zannier Hotels Phum Baitang](/accommodations/cambodia/zannier-phum-baitang/) for hydrotherapy and poolside rest before a 7:00 PM seating.

Unlike heavy Western steakhouses that leave players sluggish prior to a subsequent morning tee sheet at [Siem Reap Booyoung Country Club](/courses/cambodia/siem-reap-booyoung/), Rivière’s bi-weekly micro-seasonal menus emphasize clean river fish from the Tonle Sap, wild forest herbs, palm heart, and fermented Khmer aromatics that digest lightly while showcasing museum-grade culinary technique.

## Private Dining Room Allocation & Sommelier Pairing Notes
* **Micro-Seasonal Menu Briefings:** Because the kitchen rewrites its two tasting menus every fortnight around wild-foraged ingredients—such as winged beans, green mango, water lily stems, and Kampot peppercorn infusions—our Siem Reap concierge collects dietary profiles 14 days prior to arrival so the brigade prepares bespoke substitutions without disrupting the tasting cadence.
* ** Beverage & Natural Wine Pairings:** Guests may select between the international wine flight and the indigenous botanical cocktail pairing featuring Mekong-distilled spirits, wild honey, and bruised lemongrass.
* **Chauffeured Door-to-Door Transfers:** Wat Damnak sits 8 to 12 minutes by private luxury MPV from [Amansara](/accommodations/cambodia/amansara/) and [Raffles Grand Hotel d'Angkor](/accommodations/cambodia/raffles-grand-dangkor/), and 20 minutes from the sunset villas at [Zannier Hotels Phum Baitang](/accommodations/cambodia/zannier-phum-baitang/). Dedicated vehicles remain on standby outside the garden gate for seamless post-dinner return or onward nightcaps along [The Khmer Temple Trail](/tours/the-khmer-temple-trail/).

faqs.q: How far in advance should golf groups reserve a table at Cuisine Wat Damnak in Siem Reap?
faqs.a: During Cambodia's November-to-March dry golf season, tables at Cuisine Wat Damnak book out 3 to 5 weeks ahead, particularly for groups of 6 to 12 golfers requesting the upstairs air-conditioned dining room or garden pavilion.

faqs.q: Which Siem Reap golf course pairs best with an evening degustation at Cuisine Wat Damnak?
faqs.a: An early 07:30 tee time at Sir Nick Faldo's Angkor Golf Resort (15 minutes from central Siem Reap) allows your group to complete 18 holes before midday heat, recover at Raffles Grand Hotel d'Angkor or Zannier Phum Baitang, and arrive refreshed for a 7:00 PM tasting menu.

faqs.q: Can Cuisine Wat Damnak accommodate dietary restrictions across a multi-course Khmer tasting menu?
faqs.a: Yes. With 48 hours' notice through your Asia Golf Specialists concierge, Chef Joannès Rivière's kitchen adapts its bi-weekly Cambodian degustation for shellfish allergies, pescatarian diets, or gluten-free requirements while preserving authentic Khmer flavor profiles.
